title: Tandoori Yogurt Marinade
steps: Whisk everything together until smooth. Cut a few shallow slashes into bone-in pieces so the marinade gets in.
Add the chicken, turn to coat, cover or seal in a zip-top bag and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, ideally overnight, up to 24 hours.
## Bake: on a wire rack, hot
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C) with the rack in the upper third. Set a wire rack on a foil-lined sheet pan.

Scrape off the excess marinade so a thin coat remains (a thick layer steams instead of charring). Place the chicken on the rack and bake: bone-in thighs or drumsticks 35–40 min, boneless thighs 18–25 min. Turn the broiler on high for the last 3–5 minutes to char the edges, watching closely. Done at 165°F (74°C) for breast, 175°F (79°C) or more for thighs and drumsticks. Rest 5 minutes.
Grill over high heat, turning often, until charred in spots.
Never reuse marinade that has touched raw chicken. For basting or sauce, set some aside before adding the chicken.
